    • findDepartmentMetricPeriodAverages

      @Query("SELECT r.department.id AS departmentId,\n r.department.name AS departmentName,\n m.metric AS metric,\n AVG(CASE WHEN m.timestamp >= :currentFrom AND m.timestamp <= :to THEN m.measurement ELSE NULL END) AS currentAverage,\n AVG(CASE WHEN m.timestamp >= :previousFrom AND m.timestamp < :currentFrom THEN m.measurement ELSE NULL END) AS previousAverage\nFROM Measurement m\nJOIN m.room r\nWHERE r.active = true\n AND r.department IS NOT NULL\n AND m.timestamp >= :previousFrom\n AND m.timestamp <= :to\nGROUP BY r.department.id, r.department.name, m.metric\n") List<MeasurementRepository.DepartmentMetricPeriodAverage> findDepartmentMetricPeriodAverages(@Param("previousFrom") LocalDateTime previousFrom, @Param("currentFrom") LocalDateTime currentFrom, @Param("to") LocalDateTime to)
